_about: Hand-transcribed from the cited pages; one block per product family. Added for the p5-gaps unit: 800 V-class LT breakers and 11 kV instrument transformers and arresters.

acb_mtz2_h10.product: Schneider Electric MasterPacT MTZ2 H10, IEC 60947-2 rated, 1150 V AC
acb_mtz2_h10.note: Interrupting rating code H10 is the only MTZ2 code rated at 1150 V AC; the IEC ratings table on p.12 does not state the pole count of the H10 columns, so only the 3-pole version is catalogued.

mccb_tmax_1150v.product: ABB SACE Tmax T4, T5 and T6 circuit-breakers for use up to 1150 V AC (T6 up to 1000 V AC)
mccb_tmax_1150v.note: Icu at the rated service voltage Ue: 12 kA at 1150 V for the V versions (20 kA at 1000 V), 12 kA at 1000 V for T6 L. Rated currents are the PR221DS/PR222DS electronic trip-unit current sensors listed on p.70 (T4 250: 100 and 250 A; T5 400: 320 and 400 A; T5 630: 630 A; T6: 630 and 800 A). Thermomagnetic releases are also available but their In ladder is not transcribed.

ct_11kv.product: 11 kV single-phase outdoor dead-tank oil-filled CT (APDCL specification APDCL/PP&D/T&C/STS/HT OD CT/2020/1, section 5)
ct_11kv.note: A utility's procurement specification, not a manufacturer datasheet. The rated primary current is 'as per BPS' (bill of project specification), so no ratio is catalogued; the short-time duration is 3 s for primary currents of 150 A and above, 1 s below. Ratings are stated as tentative and may be changed to suit the project.

pt_11kv.product: 11 kV single-phase outdoor oil-filled PT (APDCL specification APDCL/PP&D/T&C/STS/HT OD PT/2020/1, section 5)
pt_11kv.note: A utility's procurement specification, not a manufacturer datasheet. Ratings are stated as tentative and may be changed to suit the project.

la_11kv.product: 11 kV station-class gapless metal-oxide surge arrester, Ur 9 kV, Uc 7.65 kV (APDCL specification APDCL/PP&D/T&C/STS/LA/2020/1, section 4.2)
la_11kv.note: A utility's procurement specification, not a manufacturer datasheet. A surge monitor is required only if the bill of project specification asks for one, so the discharge-counter flag is left unset.

mccb_easypact_solar_800v.product: Schneider Electric EasyPact Solar MCCB 400 and 800, 3P, Ue 800 V AC, IS/IEC 60947-2
mccb_easypact_solar_800v.note: Icu at 800 V AC from the technical datasheet pages A-6 to A-8 (PDF pp.17-19): MCCB 400 B/F/N 25/36/50 kA, MCCB 800 F/N 36/50 kA; commercial references on page F-3 (PDF p.58), where MCCB 400 also has ETU 160 A and MCCB 800 also has 400 A (not catalogued twice). The catalogue and the user guide SP5015101 (raw/datasheets/protection/Schneider_EasyPact_Solar_MCCB_user_guide_SP5015101.pdf pp.35-39) give no largest cable per pole: cables land on the standard spreaders. One cable lug per pole up to 300 sq.mm is a design assumption, not a datasheet value; confirm with the manufacturer.
